Several candidate lines are drawn on the Earth's surface and marked ①, ②, ③, and ④, among which line ① is located near the left side of the figure, line ② is in the upper part, line ③ is near the right side, and line ④ is in the lower part. Then reason: Beijing time is East Eighth District time, and 1:36:06 on November 3, 2011 converted to Universal Time is approximately 17:36:06 on November 2, 2011. The evening line passes through the meridian of local time 18:00 near the equator, so it should be on the side close to the 0° meridian in the figure. Combining the tilt direction of the morning-evening line when the direct solar point is in the Southern Hemisphere in November, and comparing the positions and trends of ①, ②, ③, and ④ in the figure, the one that conforms to the position of this evening line is line ①.
